notes: A campaign voice against the public sector target that NRW and other bodies report against; with Bridgend dropping its 2030 target it adds to pressure on the goal after the 2026 election.
summary: On 23 February 2026 the TaxPayers' Alliance published a note estimating that reaching net zero across the Welsh public sector by 2030 would cost between 7.8 and 13.3 billion pounds. It reported public sector net emissions of 2.6 million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent in 2023-24, with 82 percent from scope 3 emissions, and found cost estimates in only eight public bodies as of January 2026. It called for the 2030 target to be withdrawn or suspended until a fully costed and funded plan was available.
title: TaxPayers' Alliance puts the 2030 Welsh public sector net zero target at 7.8 to 13.3 billion pounds and calls for it to be withdrawn
